description: Custom mRNA vaccine design with rapid IVT production payload optimization immunogenicity assessment and formulation support.
Tumor profiling workflows to identify actionable mutations guide targeting and predict treatment response using long-read single-cell and targeted sequencing.
High-throughput viability imaging and phospho-protein analyses to prioritize rational combinations and identify biomarkers.
Organoids xenografts and DIPG or neuroblastoma models that preserve microenvironment cues for efficacy and resistance studies.
